beats.headline: The wheel picks a food truck
beats.text: The wheel clicks past a bookmobile, the Popemobile, a forklift and a missile launcher and settles on the square shape of a box truck. What crunches into place on squeaking shocks is a food truck, about twenty feet long, with a chicken in a fedora and red tie painted on the side: Big Shot Chicken, the 1920s-gangster chain whose safe room Carl and Donut sat in on the second floor. It has a faux-1920s hood, chrome fenders, round fluted headlamps, a brand-new aluminium kitchen, no passenger seat, and a plastic tommy gun on the roof. Carl turns the key. The engine starts.

beats.headline: Make way for the big shot
beats.text: Mongo is left in the truck as security and finds the horn, which is not a honk but a recording of a gangster's voice saying make way for the big shot, a chicken squawk, and a tommy gun's rat-a-tat. It is funny the first time. By the twentieth, Carl wants to rip it out. Then Mongo leans on it while Dwight's tumbleweed mount stands at the cave mouth, and the plant bursts forward, over the trailer and the van and away. There is no trailer hitch, so the flatbed carrying Team Free Love's van is chained to the welded step under the back door. Radoslav rides in the open back watching the trailer, and Jasha stays in the van.

beats.headline: Spider legs, on Hedy's advice
beats.text: In the garage, Hedy taps the trailer and does not approve of the help. Carl wants the kitchen gear out of the back and the gun off the roof, because it blocks his view. At the end of every race, Hedy explains, the truck is regenerated to its form at the start. Her tablet offers a mobility upgrade first: retractable spider legs, a hover upgrade, or all-terrain tires with vertical climb. Spider legs are her pick. Carl swipes through over a thousand options, weapons included, and hands the tablet back. Pick the spider legs. Sexy and smart, says the gremlin.

beats.headline: Over the line in the air
beats.text: Gluteus Maxx passes out at the wheel before the finish of heat three. Carl grabs the wheel, Donut rips free of her seat to stamp on the accelerator, and Carl lies on his back across the hood, steering over his shoulders, feet aimed at a kaiju skull. Then Dwight's cannon rips through the side of the truck. It flips and spins like a badly tossed football, clips the GTO and the vine, and all three go over the finish line in the air. The truck lands on its back and spins off. Tater tots, fries and chicken patties are everywhere. First place: the Royal Court.

beats.headline: Two Golden upgrades
beats.text: After the fourth heat there are two Golden upgrades to pick, and the next track needs vertical climb, inverted racing and gaps of more than a hundred metres. Hedy suggests one Golden and three regulars, and they take her advice: the Bubble Buddy shield brought up to its golden version, which floats and holds off molten steel for a while; a heat sink in case they lose containment; and the regular version of Team Sparkles' booster rockets, which with the bubble should carry them over long jumps. The Golden one is Roller Limbo, a trans-dimensional upgrade for racing upside down and slipping under any gap of ten centimetres.

beats.headline: Upside down over molten steel
beats.text: In the fifth heat the spider legs carry the truck up a flat wall and onto the ceiling, lowering its wheels onto a track, and Roller Limbo holds it there over a river of molten metal. In the back, everyone stands on the overturned counter: Donut, Grigori, Dong, Corky and Porky, blood sloshing as spells hold them together, and Grigori calls out instructions for pressing a head back together. Gorilla-like beasts of molten metal hurl globs at the racers. The heat sink gauge tops out twice, and a hole opens in the hood over the whirring engine.

beats.headline: The last float
beats.text: At the arena's huge door Carl sends Tipid out of the cab to the RV, and Bigs and a crew of blood-soaked sluggalos pile in to drive. The side server window opens, the deep fryer hisses on, and the Sluggalo Chick-Chick Express is open for business. A fryer will splash or catch fire, Carl warns; Bigs tells him to do his thing. With his face on the jumbotron, Carl pulls the last rope, the display collapses, and the massive magic missile launcher looted from Dwight stands on the roof. This is our revolution, he tells the galaxy. Floor it. The truck lurches forward and sideswipes the door, and only the gyro keeps it from flipping.

beats.headline: Spinning, burning, firing
beats.text: When Donut's Puddle Jumper brings her and Carl back out to the arena entrance, the food truck is spinning in circles, flames pouring from the side window by the deep fryer, missiles launching one after another at the Krakaren boss while sluggalos crawl over it. The Krakaren boss is in the stands with only two tentacles left. Moments on, the truck is miraculously still upright, still on fire, still spinning. Most of the sluggalos who were riding outside are gone, and the missile launcher is wrecked.
